profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at SIX Digital Exchange
profile.summary: I seek an energetic, fast-paced company where I can apply my 10+ years of experience, including 4 years in a leadership role, to add value to your products, teams, and company. I enjoy team collaboration to meet technical and operational challenges, and my track record shows that I deliver results.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- blockchain, crypto staking, Corda, MetaMask & WalletConnect API
- React, NextJS, Nx monorepo
- Node, NestJS, TypeORM
- Typescript, Kotlin, Clojure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- implemented UI redesign (React, Redux, Saga)
- added endpoints and functionality to REST api’s (Node, Azure)
- added support for new assets and new validation rules to backend services (Node, Azure)
- added antivirus support (Node, ClamAV api)
- updated various management scripts (python)
- updated DLT contracts (Solidity)

positions.title: Sr. Lead Developer
positions.description:
- lead developer for 2 major branches of CAT (Angular, Node, and Python)
- UI/UX - worked with business team to design and develop new UI, and improve CAT UX
- developed strategies necessary to release a multitude of features under aggressive deadlines
- interviewed candidates for fullstack and frontend positions

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
- built the foundation for the Thesys CAT project, including unit and e2e test coverage (Angular, Node, and Python)
- worked with design team to develop style guide for CAT
- routinely performed code reviews for frontend and fullstack work
- helped develop and document REST api’s.

positions.title: Manager of Front End Development
positions.description:
- worked with team leads to overhaul processes across teams to decrease level of effort by 40%
- coached direct reports to help them independently manage their own teams and projects
- collaborated with creative leads to drive innovation and improve workflow to meet company goals

positions.title: Supervisor of Front End Development
positions.description:
- worked with my team to design and implement our technical and operational strategy 
- helped move marketing team through challenges such as high volume, short deadlines, and challenging client relationships
- worked directly with clients to resolve issues and improve client satisfaction

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
- rewrote our base template and updated workflow with design to increase team efficiency by 20%
- designed and developed modular tools for my team, clients, and their customers
- high intensity, fast-paced work environment

positions.title: Digital Consulting and Development
positions.description:
- provide technical consulting and development for web and server side projects
- rewrote BASIC scripts in C# to run on new servers; eliminated redundant tasks
- consult on redesign and UX for their website

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- fullstack development
- developed new features on multiple platforms: ATG, Java, JSP, PHP, ASP, ColdFusion
- client facing - worked regularly with Jenny Craig, Intel, and Freightliner 
- fast-paced, balanced multiple projects with tight deadlines

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
- built custom CMS’s for ecommerce sites using PHP and MYSQL
- implemented authorize.net API, user login, content and account management
- built an amortization calculator in C#, so employees could easily give payment info to customers
